rfp.subject: Leadership offsite request, 2027-06-02, 18 guests, 2 nights
rfp.body:
Hello,

We are looking for a leadership offsite venue.

Arrival: 2027-06-02 (alternative 2027-06-09), 2 nights.
Guests: 18, in single rooms (36 room nights).
Meeting space: one plenary meeting room for 18, plus breakout rooms if available.
Catering: day delegate package with lunch and coffee, plus dinners.
Dietary: 3 vegan, 2 gluten-free.
Accessibility: 1 wheelchair user, so we need step-free access and an accessible bedroom.
Budget: up to EUR 12,000 in total.

Please send your offer, with a price breakdown, by 2026-10-25.

Thank you,
Demo Co.
